.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.1.name: mtxrNetwatchIndex
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.1.description: Netwatch entry id (stable while the entry exists)

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.2.name: mtxrNetwatchName
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.2.description: Netwatch entry name; empty if the entry is unnamed

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.3.name: mtxrNetwatchHost
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.3.description: Probed host as configured: DNS name, or literal IPv4/IPv6 address

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.5.name: mtxrNetwatchStatus
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.5.description: Result of the last test. unknown(0) means the entry is disabled or has not completed a test yet

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.6.name: mtxrNetwatchSince
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.6.description: Time of the last status change, as seconds since 1970-01-01 in router local time; 0 if no status change happened yet

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.7.name: mtxrNetwatchDoneTests
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.7.description: Number of tests performed. Resets when the entry is disabled/re-enabled or the router reboots

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.8.name: mtxrNetwatchFailedTests
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.8.description: Number of failed tests. Resets when the entry is disabled/re-enabled or the router reboots

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.9.name: mtxrNetwatchSentCount
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.9.description: Probes sent in the last test window; icmp probes only, 0 for other types

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.10.name: mtxrNetwatchResponseCount
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.10.description: Responses received in the last test window; icmp probes only, 0 for other types

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.11.name: mtxrNetwatchLossCount
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.11.description: Probes lost in the last test window; icmp probes only, 0 for other types

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.12.name: mtxrNetwatchLossRate
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.12.description: Packet loss in the last test window in per-mille (0..1000, divide by 10 for percent); icmp probes only

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.13.name: mtxrNetwatchRttAvg
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.13.description: Average round trip time in the last test window; icmp probes only, 0 when no responses were received

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.14.name: mtxrNetwatchRttMin
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.14.description: Minimal round trip time in the last test window; icmp probes only, 0 when no responses were received

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.15.name: mtxrNetwatchRttMax
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.15.description: Maximal round trip time in the last test window; icmp probes only, 0 when no responses were received

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.16.name: mtxrNetwatchRttJitter
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.16.description: Round trip time jitter (max - min) in the last test window; icmp probes only, 0 when no responses were received

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.17.name: mtxrNetwatchRttStdev
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.17.description: Round trip time standard deviation in the last test window; icmp probes only, 0 when no responses were received

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.18.name: mtxrNetwatchTcpConnectTime
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.18.description: Time to establish the TCP connection in the last test; tcp-conn, http-get and https-get probes only, 0 for other types

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.19.name: mtxrNetwatchHttpStatusCode
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.19.description: HTTP status code of the last test; http-get and https-get probes only, 0 when no response was received

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.20.name: mtxrNetwatchHttpRespTime
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.26.1.1.20.description: Time until the HTTP response was received in the last test; http-get and https-get probes only
